description: Send a custom ping to a room the account belongs to. Pass data.checklist.items to send a checklist the room ticks through together; read the ticks back as checklist_state. Rate-limited. In someone else's personal room only a Pro account may send it, text only (a link in the message is refused too), without title, is_urgent or requires_ack (all three are ignored there), and it counts toward the visitor's two-ping cap; otherwise use trigger_quick_action there.

ack_mode.description: With requires_ack: any (default) resolves on the first confirmation; all waits for every original eligible recipient. Read action_state.confirmed_count and required_count for progress.

action_icon.description: Optional emoji shown with the ping.

action_number.description: Optional quick-action slot to attribute the ping to.

attachment_ids.description: Ids of up to 4 uploaded attachments (see upload_attachment) to include. Uploading requires a Pro account.

correlation_id.description: Your own id, echoed back unchanged on read.

data.description: Arbitrary structured context (max 25 keys / 8KB). Read surfaces return it after connector privacy filtering; do not put secrets in data. data.location is reserved for a shareable location, data.checklist for a checklist, and data.url + data.button_label are reserved for a tappable link ping. data.actions is reserved for up to 3 buttons.

actions.description: Reserved: up to 3 buttons on the notification and the ping's card. open_url opens an https link (the app shows its host); webhook makes PingRoom POST a signed notification.action event to your https URL when a recipient taps it (once per person, for 24 hours; the room owner must be Pro). Not in public or personal rooms, not with requires_ack. The answer carries action_signing_secret to verify deliveries with. A label may not contain a web address or domain, or copy one of PingRoom's own buttons.

body.description: webhook only: a JSON object (at most 1024 bytes) echoed back to your URL as `body` on every tap. Never shown to recipients.

id.description: Your id for the button, unique on the ping; defaults to a1, a2, a3.

url.description: https only, a public hostname (punycode for an internationalized one), no user name or password. A webhook URL takes no port.

button_label.description: Reserved: label for the link button rendered for data.url.

checklist.description: A short checklist the room can tick through, e.g. a shopping list. The room ticks it together: a checked item is checked for everyone, cannot be unchecked, and alerts the other recipients.

label.description: Reserved: short caption shown with the link ping.
Optional place name shown to the recipient.

url.description: Reserved: an absolute http:// or https:// URL. Present turns the ping into a tappable link.

is_urgent.description: Deliver time-sensitive so the ping breaks through Focus / Do Not Disturb and reaches members who muted the room or you (a block still wins). Independent of requires_ack: urgent affects delivery only and asks nothing of the recipient.

message.description: Ping body text (max 120 characters in private rooms, 160 in public rooms).

replace_key.description: Your own handle for "the ping I keep updating" (1 to 64 characters: letters, digits and . _ : -). A send with a replace_key replaces your earlier ping with the same key in the same room, instead of sending a new one, while that ping is under 24 hours old, replaced fewer than 20 times and replaceable (see replace_notification); the answer is then 200 with the same id and replaced: true. Otherwise a new ping is sent and keeps the key. A send that asks for something a replacement cannot do (requires_ack, is_urgent, attachment_ids, tags, action_number, or a different correlation_id, reply_to or action_icon) always sends a new ping.

reply_to.description: Id of the ping this one answers (notification id or correlation id).

requires_ack.description: Keep this ping open until its confirmation rule is met, and show it as a lock-screen card with an Acknowledge button. Does not raise the interruption level on its own — combine with is_urgent for an ack that also breaks through Focus.

tags.description: Up to 10 labels to file this ping under, so history can later be filtered by one (list_notifications and wait_for_notification take a tag). Each is 1 to 32 characters: lowercase letters, digits, "-" and "_", starting with a letter or digit. Trimmed, lowercased and de-duplicated for you.

title.description: Optional headline. Defaults to the room name, which someone else's personal room always keeps.

name: broadcast

result.description: A privacy-minimized, chainable PingRoom notification result.

action_signing_secret.description: broadcast with a webhook button: the secret every delivery of this ping's buttons is signed with (X-PingRoom-Signature-V2). Returned only here; keep it to verify the deliveries.

actions.description: The buttons the sender put on the ping: {id, label, type, style}, plus url and host for an open_url button. A webhook button never shows where it goes. Present only on a ping with buttons.

actions_expire_at.description: When the ping's buttons stop running (24 hours after it was sent).

checklist_state.description: Present once an item of data.checklist is checked: ticks[] of {index, checked_at, checked_by.display_name}. A checked item stays checked.

data.description: Structured context after connector privacy filtering. Credential, account, and direct-contact fields are removed.

edited_at.description: When the sender last replaced the ping's text (null when never). Present on reads; on a list or the broadcast answer only once the ping has been replaced.

origin_agent.description: Present when a connected agent originated the ping: its handle and display name.

replaced.description: broadcast with a replace_key: true when the send replaced your earlier ping (same id) instead of sending a new one.

tags.description: Labels the sender put on the ping, sorted alphabetically; [] when none.

withdrawn_at.description: When the sending agent took the ping back with withdraw_notification (null when never). The ping stays in the room's history with its text. Present on reads; on a list or the broadcast answer only once the ping has been withdrawn.

title: Broadcast Ping
